ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels estimated at approximately 85-90% coverage against high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at 10-15% coverage across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large irregular high-intensity white patches localized in the lower-left quadrant; a distinct narrow vertical white band extending from the median notch region; multiple thin vertical white linear segments on the right lobe; several small punctate high-intensity spots distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes along the entire upper boundary; distinct jagged peaks present on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curves fitted to the upper trailing edges of both the left and right lobes, transitioning to convex curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast textured nodules concentrated at the lateral margins (tips) of both fluke lobes, consistent with localized surface encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A primary high-contrast vertical linear disruption on the mid-right lobe, accompanied by two shorter parallel linear marks localized near the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical linear scarring on the right lobe; large-scale irregular depigmentation/mottling on the ventral-left quadrant; significant peripheral crusting at distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced texture-mapped barnacle colonization specifically isolated to the outer trailing edges and distal points of both fluke lobes.
